what: the day's ranked clusters, in the desk's own one line, sources counted and linked (Jack, 5 October 2026)
what_a_wire_line_is: Each line is the desk's own one-line summary of a story it ranked, with its sources counted and linked. It is not a story the desk wrote or checked; only the item with a badge was checked.

items.line: Brazilian firms and traders fled to USDT and Bitcoin as BRL crashed on election day, driving stablecoin volume up 800% and BTC volume 865% on local exchanges.

checked.says: CoinDesk reports the OCC approved Ripple National Trust Bank to manage RLUSD reserves and provide fiduciary digital asset custody, with the stablecoin issued by Ripple's New York-regulated unit.
checked.unconfirmed: Decrypt lists RLUSD at $2.5 billion in market value; The Defiant states $2.6 billion, sources read diverge slightly on the exact figure.
